page.notes: The Greek phrase ἐφ᾽ ᾧ is set in the italic paragraph and is marked [?] because the accent and breathing are hard to read at this scan resolution. The word "genita" in the first paragraph is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "clesiam" completes the hyphenated word "Ec-clesiam" split at the line end.
